title: Sony WH-1000XM4C (M4 2nd Gen) Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones, Black
description: Escape the noise and step into an elevated listening experience with the WH-1000XM4C Noise Cancelling Headphones. High-fidelity audio, lightweight comfort, clear call quality, and a timeless design come together with up to 27 hours of battery life, giving you refined sound and effortless style wherever the day takes you.
features: 1000X SERIES NOISE CANCELLING: Inspired by the premium noise cancelling performance of the 1000X Series, the WH-1000XM4C helps quiet everyday distractions from streets, traffic, offices, and transportation, so you can focus on your own sound.
PREMIUM SOUND QUALITY: Enjoy trusted 1000X sound with high-fidelity audio, custom sound tuning, and features designed for today’s music, movies, games, and everyday listening.

SONY | SOUND CONNECT APP CUSTOMIZATION: Fine-tune your sound in the Sony | Sound Connect app with a 10-band equalizer, shortcut settings, listening history, and Safe Listening tools for a more personalized experience.

HIGH-FIDELITY SOUND, REFINED: DSEE Extreme uses Edge-AI to upscale compressed digital music files in real time, helping restore high-range sound lost during compression for a richer listening experience. LDAC transmits about three times more data than conventional Bluetooth audio, helping you enjoy high-resolution audio content wirelessly with quality that comes closer to a dedicated wired connection.

LIGHTWEIGHT, FOLDABLE DESIGN: At approximately 253g, the WH-1000XM4C is lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear, with a foldable design and included carrying case that make it easy to bring along for travel, commutes, or everyday use.

ALL-DAY POWER WITH QUICK CHARGING: Get up to 27 hours of battery life for all-day listening, plus quick charging that gives you up to 1 hour of playback from a 3-minute charge when you’re short on time.
CLEAR CALL QUALITY: Precise Voice Pickup Technology uses multiple microphones and advanced audio signal processing to help your voice come through clearly on calls.
MULTIPOINT CONNECTION: Pair with two Bluetooth devices at the same time and switch automatically when a call comes in or audio starts on either device.
SIMPLE, INUITIVE CONTROL: Control music and volume right from the earcup. Tap, swipe, or double-tap to play, pause, skip tracks, and adjust volume without reaching for your phone.
included_components: Headphones, Protective Case, Headphone cable, User Manual

title: LEGO Star Wars SMART Play: Millennium Falcon 75426
description: Role-play as iconic characters on the Millennium Falcon (75426) with this endlessly playful LEGO Star Wars building toy for kids. The brick-built model of the famous starship has 2 stud shooters and lift-off/foldout top sections for easy access to the detailed interior. Play holochess, practice Lightsaber skills or just relax in the seating area. This LEGO SMART Play Compatible Set includes 4 LEGO SMART minifigures – SMART Han Solo, SMART Chewbacca, SMART Luke Skywalker and SMART C-3PO – and 4 SMART Tags. Add a SMART Brick from All-In-One Sets 75421, 75423 or 75427 (sold separately) for interactive play with dynamic lights and sounds, including the hyperdrive leaping to light speed, laser-shooting battles, fuel explosions, Lightsaber clashes, and more. Kids can build with confidence using the LEGO Builder app – zoom, rotate in 3D and track progress with easy-to-follow digital instructions. A super gift for boys, girls and Star Wars fans ages 9 plus, this set contains 885 pieces.
features: COMPATIBLE WITH LEGO SMART BRICK (NOT INCLUDED) - Create new adventures with iconic characters as they come to life with LEGO SMART Play. Place the LEGO SMART BRICK (included separately in All-in-One sets) in the ship to hear the sounds of the Millennium Falcon and the crew as they fight off the Empire
4 LEGO STAR WARS MINIFIGURES – Role-play Star Wars: A New Hope scenes with SMART Han Solo, SMART Chewbacca, SMART Luke Skywalker and SMART C-3PO, plus accessories including Luke’s blue Lightsaber
BUILT FOR PLAY – Activate the 2 stud shooters, fold out/remove the top panels for easy, imaginative play inside the starship, play holochess, practice Lightsaber skills with Luke, and more
ACTIVATE THE SMART PLAY SYSTEM – The 4 SMART Tags and 4 LEGO SMART Minifigures activate the SMART Brick from All-In-One Sets (sold separately) for responsive play with dynamic sounds and lights
STAR WARS GIFT FOR KIDS – This highly detailed set makes a fantastic gift for kids, boys, girls and fans ages 9 and up who enjoy creative play
ENHANCED INTERACTIVE FUN – The LEGO Builder app helps kids build independently with tools that let them zoom in and rotate sets using 3D instructions, track progress and more
THE GALAXY PLAYS BACK – Expand the LEGO Star Wars adventure with the SMART Play system, featuring All-In-One Sets and Compatible Sets (sold separately) that bring endlessly responsive play to life
DIMENSIONS – The Millennium Falcon in this 885-piece set measures over 3.5 in. (9 cm) high, 10.5 in. (27 cm) long and 9 in. (24 cm) wide
special_features: Since 1958, LEGO bricks have met the highest industry standards, so they are consistent, compatible and connect and come apart easily every time – and it's still that way today
included_components: SMART Brick NOT Included, 4 LEGO SMART Tags, 4 LEGO SMART Minifigures, 885 LEGO Building Elements
